page.layout: One page of text, no margin notes. Top: printed page number "IO" centred above an ornamental headpiece. Below it: a centred division title "PARS CRITICES.", a centred Greek title with an italic "Idest:" and a centred italic subtitle in three lines. Then "CAP. I." and the chapter text in one column with a woodcut initial I. Last line of the text is a catchword at the right.

main_text.head: PARS CRITICES.
ΤΡΟΠΟΣ ΕΠΙΛΥΣΕΩΣ ΦΑΥ-λων ἐλέγχων.

p.i: Ratio solvendi vitiosas argumentationes, compendiosè & methodicè tradita & explicata in Academia Cattorum, à Rod. Goclenio.

main_text.head: CAP. I.
main_text.p: 2. Materia est in Enuncia-tis & Notionibus, sive signa rerum: (terminos & extrema vocant) sive Res Ipsas spectes.
3. Forma est in legitima deductione seu dianœa syllogistica. Et continetur certa Figura & Modo. Itaque hæc duo in ea spectantur.
4. Figura consistit in dispositione Me-dii legitima.

page.notes: Woodcut headpiece above the title and a woodcut initial I at the start of chapter 1: not text. The Greek title line is partly hard to read: "ΕΠΙΛΥΣΕΩΣ" and "ΦΑΥ-λων" are my best reading and may contain errors. The paragraph number "5." is an uncertain shape. The long s is written as s throughout, and the catchword "nuncia-" is taken as printed.
